LESSON: EXPLORING

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social 2.2 Enterprise projects By the end of the sub-strand, the learner  Learn
Topic 2.2.2: Exploring

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Exploring
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Exploring
2. give Kenyan examples of Exploring
3. practise a safe skill for Exploring

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Exploring

Teach
• Observe Exploring in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Exploring (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Exploring.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Exploring.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Exploring.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Exploring.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Exploring: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Exploring with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
